## `neuro.weakSet.delete`

Instance method on `WeakSet.prototype`.

> Removes the specified element from the WeakSet.

## Signatures

```ts
delete(input: { weakSet: <receiver>; value: T; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `WeakSet.prototype.delete` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
